neg_samples.title: Don't do it
neg_samples.text: I purchased this grill on all the fine review I read about it, but I think they were all done by friends and relatives of the manufacturer. Assembly was no problem, BUT! Hose from regulator to burner was crushed, had to make a new one. Spark igniter will not lite the burner (have bent it every which way possible no luck have to use a propane torch to light the burner). Also spark igniter will only work if push the button in just right, which doesn't make much difference any way since it will not lite the burner. Once you get the first burner lit it will not carry over to next, unfortunately I didn't look in time. The delayed ignition nearly lifted the heavy griddle top off the base. I'm at an age that I don't need that kind of excitement. Have to use the torch to lite the burners one by one. Not an easy job. The burners will also flash back and burn at the orifice causing the burner to glow cherry red, not a good thing. Have to play with the burner control to get it to stop. Yes I have a new full tank of gas which I know works since I took it off my old rusty grill, which by the way always lites off with no problems. Will it cook, yes and does a decent job at that for a cheap flat top. I would only recommend this unit to someone who doesn't mind a little excitement in their life and doesn't mind if they have to spend some time getting things working before cooking. I can not recommend this unit, very poor design and does not work as advertised.

neg_samples.title: Loved it until it rained out and cover failed...
neg_samples.text: Loved it until it rained out and the blackstone griddle cover failed to keep the rain out/off the griddle and the entire top griddle rusted badly. As a result of the NOT rainproof cover I had to scour the top and reseason the griddle only a week after I had seasoned it originally. These were bad rust stains and took forever to get rid of (there is still some staining that I can't get out)! I am absolutely flabbergasted to discover that blackstone products would provide a cover that doesn't keep the rain out. Obviously, I had to purchase a PVC cover for the griddle at a cost of about $60.00...kinda lousy, for sure. Anyway, I enjoy the griddle, but wanted people to know that they should discard the cover if they have the griddle outside where it can get rained on. I hope I saved some people the hassle I just went through! Good day all!!

We went outside to wait for delivery because we live minutes from the local walmart, and to help assist with unloading because it's a heavy item. While outside, I get the "delivered" text message. The photo is literally a picture of the box. Not my house, not my door, nothing to help identify if it was delivered the wrong address. A zoomed in picture of the box. I contact walmart immediately, chat told me they'll send refund request. Refund got denied 4 times. After so much back and forth, the latest rep told me to file a chargeback and file a police report. Which I have done, and have provided camera footage that no one ever showed up to my house. I live in a relative small neighborhood and drove around to look if it was misdelivered. I reached out to chat and asked if they could update notes on my profile with the police report number so they could see the video footage. The rep ended the call, and would not take any additional notes. So I am left writing this review to warn future buyers. Do a pickup instead, NEVER order online for delivery.
